dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim

WORKDIR /app

COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

COPY . .

CMD ["python", "-c", "print('QGIS environment ready')"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes all detected imports except PyQt4 (deprecated), sipconfig, and sipbuild (build tools not needed in runtime). Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs requirements, and sets up a minimal QGIS-compatible environment. PyQt6 is included for forward compatibility while prioritizing PyQt5.
